candidates.explanation: The default provider is AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is undefined. AuthService.register doesn't set a provider, so email-registered users are stored with provider 'google'. Login then fails the `user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email` check and returns `needLoginViaProvider:google`.
register() doesn't pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email to usersService.create, so it relies on the wrong default.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email in UsersService.create. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
